purpose: Verify whether the public CooperScene release can support a trace-preserving, frame-level C-V2X replay experiment without inventing unavailable measurements.

repository.commitSubject: Add DATA_LICENSE: dataset is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, code remains MIT

evidencePolicy.directObservation: A value decoded from the audited commit, an official portal object, a ZIP central directory, or an MCAP record read during this audit.
evidencePolicy.codeInference: A behavior implied by an inspected executable code path but not exercised end to end with a model checkpoint.
evidencePolicy.documentationClaim: A claim made by the official paper, project page, README, or portal that was not assumed to exist in the binary schema until independently observed.
evidencePolicy.nonFabricationRule: Unavailable latency, packet-loss, jitter, PHY, MAC, scheduling, or packet-event fields must remain unavailable; they may not be synthesized and relabeled as measured CooperScene observations.

mini.evidence: The ZIP central directory was range-read and mechanically enumerated. No .mcap entry was present.

availabilityNotes: The UCR server returned Accept-Ranges: bytes for mini.zip, per-take ZIP archives, full MCAP files, and preview MCAP files.
The repository README correctly states that MCAP recordings are distributed separately from train, validate, and test archives.
A Hugging Face dataset API request timed out after 10 seconds during this audit. The UCR portal remained accessible and is the audited data authority.

GitHub issue 2 contained an official 2026-07-22 reply saying dataset hosting on Hugging Face could be discussed in the future; the existing Hugging Face repository should not be assumed to be a complete dataset mirror.

rangeReadSampleMethod.goal: Recover published MCAP structure and real message values without downloading a multi-gigabyte take.

steps.result: Decoded a valid MCAP footer and magic. summary_start=230633137 and summary_offset_start=230732008.
Parsed 299 summary records: 25 Schema, 25 Channel, 242 ChunkIndex, 1 Statistics, and 6 SummaryOffset records.
Decoded a valid MCAP footer. summary_start=2404308733 and summary_offset_start=2404378316.
Recovered the complete full-take schema, channel inventory, message counts, time range, and chunk indexes.
Decompressed and parsed 5 Schema, 13 Channel, and 9 Message records, including three directed throughput samples.
Enumerated every mini.zip entry without downloading the full archive.
Verified that frame identity is carried by the filename while the YAML contains pose and object labels but no absolute MCAP timestamp or network observation.

boundedScope: No complete MCAP, scene archive, or mini.zip was downloaded.
Only the first compressed chunk of full take 9 was decoded for payload values.
The schema and channel inventory are complete for full take 9 because they were recovered from its MCAP summary.
The three numeric throughput values are a bounded sample and are not claimed to summarize the take distribution.

directedThroughput.directionSemantics: The topic prefix identifies the receiver and the suffix identifies the sender.

timestampObservations.mcapRecordTime: Nanosecond Unix-epoch log_time and publish_time are present in each MCAP Message record.
timestampObservations.datasetFrameIdentity: The take 9 scene ZIP contains exactly 161 contiguous YAML frame names per agent, from 540600 through 540760.
timestampObservations.alignmentLimitation: The sampled YAML contains no absolute MCAP timestamp. Equal counts and ordering are insufficient as a permanent alignment contract; a checked per-take mapping must be generated and stored.

throughputFieldSemantics.layoutEvidence: The official CooperScene Foxglove layout plots only .x for every throughput topic.
throughputFieldSemantics.unitInterpretation: Mbps is supported by the repository's cv2x_throughput parameter and benchmark documentation, but the unit is not encoded in the Protobuf schema itself.
throughputFieldSemantics.sampledYAndZ: Both y and z were zero in all three decoded throughput messages.
throughputFieldSemantics.claimBoundary: The bounded sample does not establish that y and z are zero in every message or every take.

explicitlyMissingPublishedChannels.interpretation: The official project describes latency, throughput, packet loss, and jitter, but the complete full-take-9 MCAP summary exposes only directed throughput topics for network observations. This audit found no executable field for the other metrics in that published MCAP.

currentConverter.observation: The converter walks static split/take/agent frame files and does not read an MCAP trace.

miniBundledPkl.binaryPathObservation: Bundled PKL lidar_path values use .bin paths, while mini.zip contains no .bin entries.

inconsistencies: The bundled mini PKLs label the dataset OPV2V, while the audited converter writes CooperScene.
The bundled mini PKLs rotate agent 0, 1, 2, and 3 through the ego role, while the audited converter allows only vehicle agents 1, 2, and 3 as ego.
The bundled mini PKLs contain 4 samples per frame; the audited converter would produce 3 samples per frame.
The bundled mini PKLs contain no network trace field or MCAP-to-frame alignment.
The bundled PKLs reference .bin point clouds that are not shipped in mini.zip.
requiredDisposition: Regenerate all experiment PKLs with the audited converter commit and --convert-pcd, or with a reviewed successor converter.
Do not mix bundled mini PKLs with newly converted full-data PKLs in one comparison.
Store converter commit, arguments, output hash, ego-agent policy, and frame counts in the experiment manifest.
Generate a separate checked trace-alignment sidecar rather than mutating unverified bundled PKLs in place.

officialNetworkModelAudit.delayCalculation: time_delay_ms = data_size_Mb / transmission_speed_Mbps * 1000 + optional overhead and backbone delay
officialNetworkModelAudit.table2ScriptObservation: tools/run_table2.sh defaults every agent setting to 1.6 Mbps and instructs users to edit the values to measured throughputs.
officialNetworkModelAudit.modelConditioningRisk: models/cooperative/detectors/cooperative_detector.py constructs zero prior_encoding values for time_delay, velocity, and infrastructure when no value is supplied. Delayed input selection alone does not inform delay-aware models of the actual replay delay.
officialNetworkModelAudit.reproducibilityBoundary: A trace replay extension must not be described as the unchanged official Table 2 network implementation.

minimalReplayInsertionPoints.change: Add explicit trace_root, trace_mode, payload_bits or payload-size source, alignment-manifest path, missing-link policy, and trace fingerprint configuration.
minimalReplayInsertionPoints.reason: Replay configuration must be immutable and recorded before evaluation.

minimalReplayInsertionPoints.change: Load and validate a per-take trace/alignment sidecar before sample parsing.
minimalReplayInsertionPoints.reason: The current PKL contains no MCAP absolute time or network measurements.

minimalReplayInsertionPoints.change: Replace the scalar _time_delay call with a scheduler lookup keyed by scenario, receiver ego agent_id, sender cooperator agent_id, current frame, and payload size.
minimalReplayInsertionPoints.reason: The directed topic schema is receiver/sender specific, while the current delay function receives no link identity.

minimalReplayInsertionPoints.change: For throughput-only replay, accumulate observed service per 100 ms interval until the payload completes, then return the latest delivered source frame, completion delay, Age of Information, and explicit missing-data status.
minimalReplayInsertionPoints.reason: A separate scheduler can be calibrated independently of perception and prevents benchmark code from silently inventing packet behavior.

minimalReplayInsertionPoints.location: models/cooperative/datasets/coop_dataset.py:_attach_coops and the cooperative input packing path
minimalReplayInsertionPoints.change: Carry replay delay, Age of Information, sender identity, receiver identity, completion status, and trace provenance into the packed sample.
minimalReplayInsertionPoints.reason: The current attached cooperator entry retains only agent_id, lidar_path, feature count, and optional images.

minimalReplayInsertionPoints.change: Populate prior_encoding.time_delay from the replay result when the evaluated model consumes it; otherwise document that the model is intentionally delay-unaware.
minimalReplayInsertionPoints.reason: Leaving prior_encoding at zero creates a mismatch between stale inputs and model conditioning.

minimalReplayInsertionPoints.change: Create and validate a per-take mapping between MCAP time and dataset frame number, including monotonicity, duplicate, missing, and maximum alignment-error checks.
minimalReplayInsertionPoints.reason: The scene YAML has only filename frame identity and no absolute MCAP timestamp.

missingReplayDependencies: No MCAP parser is declared in requirements.txt.
No Protobuf runtime is declared for decoding Foxglove schemas.
No explicit zstd Python dependency is declared for compressed MCAP chunks.

gpuMemory.documentedBatchDefaults: Per-GPU defaults are 2 for some CoBEVT configurations and 4 for several other cooperative configurations.
gpuMemory.safeAuditStatement: No minimum VRAM can be claimed from the public artifacts. A smoke test should begin at batch_size=1 and record actual peak allocation for each checkpoint.

storage.additionalConversionRisk: PCD-to-BIN conversion writes additional point-cloud files and therefore requires storage beyond the extracted archives.
storage.planningRule: Storage plans must include archives, extracted sensor data, converted BIN files, selected MCAP files, checkpoints, caches, and outputs; archive size alone is insufficient.

silentFallbackRisks.behavior: A broad except Exception block skips a cooperator and continues.
silentFallbackRisks.risk: Missing, unreadable, or incompatible cooperator data can be silently converted into a lower-agent experiment.
silentFallbackRisks.requiredMitigation: Fail closed in audited evaluation, or emit a structured failure record and exclude the sample under a preregistered rule. Report effective cooperator counts.

silentFallbackRisks.behavior: Delayed lookup clamps to the first available frame.
silentFallbackRisks.risk: Large delays at a take boundary can silently reuse the first frame instead of representing no delivered message.
silentFallbackRisks.requiredMitigation: Replay must distinguish not-yet-delivered, expired, dropped, and valid stale messages.

silentFallbackRisks.behavior: If delayed lookup returns None, the current cooperator frame remains selected.
silentFallbackRisks.risk: A failed delay lookup can silently become a synchronized message.
silentFallbackRisks.requiredMitigation: A missing replay lookup must never fall back to the current frame.

silentFallbackRisks.behavior: Missing prior_encoding is replaced by zeros.
silentFallbackRisks.risk: The evaluated model may receive stale features while being told the delay is zero.
silentFallbackRisks.requiredMitigation: Require explicit prior encoding for delay-aware configurations or record that the model is delay-unaware.

silentFallbackRisks.behavior: The release contains stale OPV2V-labeled PKLs and absent .bin targets.
silentFallbackRisks.risk: A smoke test can appear to use the current converter while actually evaluating a different ego-role and metadata contract.
silentFallbackRisks.requiredMitigation: Regenerate PKLs and fingerprint them before any result is accepted.

prohibitions: Do not claim exact CooperScene latency replay from the audited public take 9 MCAP; no independent latency field was observed.
Do not claim packet-loss replay, packet-level burst analysis, or loss-episode reconstruction; no packet event or named loss field was observed.
Do not claim jitter replay; no named jitter field was observed.
Do not assign Vector3.y or Vector3.z to latency, loss, or jitter without primary producer-schema evidence and a new binary audit.
Do not call throughput-derived serialization completion time a measured end-to-end latency.
Do not multiply throughput by an invented one-minus-loss term or inject a synthetic loss process and label it CooperScene measured loss.
Do not infer PHY or MAC causes, resource scheduling, RSSI, congestion-control state, or radio contention from the observed throughput channel alone.
Do not treat equal frame counts or sorted order as a verified MCAP-to-sensor alignment contract.
Do not use the bundled mini PKLs as evidence of the audited converter's current output.
Do not mix four-ego bundled mini PKLs with three-ego regenerated PKLs in a comparison.
Do not allow missing trace records, failed point-cloud loads, or delayed lookup failures to fall back silently to synchronized data.
Do not claim official Table 2 reproduction after replacing its scalar network model with a new trace scheduler.
Do not report a GPU-memory requirement that was not measured for the exact checkpoint, configuration, batch size, and hardware.
Do not redistribute CooperScene sensor data, annotations, traces, or derivatives under the repository's MIT code license; the dataset is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
Do not elevate the three decoded throughput values into a distributional claim about take 9 or the full dataset.

auditDisposition.traceReplayFeasibility: conditionally feasible for directed throughput-driven frame delivery
auditDisposition.exactPublishedMetricsReplay: not feasible from the audited take 9 MCAP for latency, packet loss, or jitter
blockingPrerequisites: Regenerate and fingerprint PKLs under the audited converter contract.
Build and validate a per-take MCAP-to-frame alignment sidecar.
Implement a link-aware scheduler with explicit missing and boundary states.
Remove or instrument silent synchronized-data and cooperator-drop fallbacks.
Run a batch_size=1 CUDA smoke test with one published checkpoint.
Freeze payload semantics and workload-extrapolation limits before evaluating perception outcomes.
